title: Pricing risk staircase and fast-track approval playbook
creator: Ava Patel
description: Goal: Create a risk-based approval staircase and a complementary fast-track approval path to standardize discounting decisions, reduce friction for low-risk PLG upsells, and enable rapid experiments to optimize price elasticity for Dedicated and Private customers. Scope includes: 1) a 4-tier risk classification (Tier 0 — PLG low-risk; Tier 1 — standard SMB/SMB+; Tier 2 — strategic/mid-market; Tier 3 — enterprise/high-risk) with clear discount ceilings and required approvers; 2) rules and guardrails for a fast-track flow (auto-approved up to X% with quota checks, AE quotas, and pre-approved templates); 3) integration points with security questionnaire (SQR) and Legal/Finance review queues; 4) experiment framework and telemetry to measure revenue impact, close velocity impact, and approval latency improvement; 5) update plan for the canonical pricebook and Sales enablement assets. Out-of-scope: wholesale contract template changes and external quoting tooling rework (these are separate projects).
acceptance_criteria: Canonical 4-tier risk taxonomy documented in Confluence with decision matrix
Discount ceilings and mandatory approvers defined for each tier
Fast-track flow implemented as a clear checklist that sales can execute without manual Legal/Finance approval for Tier 0/1 where thresholds are met
Telemetry events emitted from quote flow: approval_request.created, approval_request.decision, discount_applied, experiment_assignments
A/B experiment plan defined with success metrics (ARR uplift, win rate delta, time-to-close reduction, approval latency) and target sample sizes
Pilot executed with two AE pods and results synthesized into a recommendation to scale or iterate

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-permissive fast-track leads to revenue leakage. Mitigation: strict ceilings, automated quota checks, tagging for post-hoc audit and weekly Finance review.
Risk: Security questionnaire gaps for mid-market deals. Mitigation: block fast-track when SQR indicates >low risk and require Legal review.
Risk: Confusion in Sales on thresholds. Mitigation: one-page cheat sheet, in-UI guidance, mandatory training for AE pilots.
